title: docs(adr): ADR-0152 a SCIM group grants only an ordinary permission set, through a per-connection mapping row
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi92haYJXRXgYVH2zaQ11o5Pd)_

Fixes #30959

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新增 ADR-0152，记录 SCIM 组映射的已裁决定（映射按 SCIM 连接存为平台对象行、IdP 组永不授予管理员身份、厂商版本 1.7.12），并在 ADR-0134 D4 下加一行指向；ADR 索引随之重新生成。
- 为什么改：卡 #30959 的裁决「以上都同意」第 3 项要求新立 ADR 记录这次决定；功能代码已在 #31443 落地，这是该卡最后一个 PR。
- 风险与回滚：纯文档，不改任何代码与行为；ADR 只记录已裁事项，不做新决定。回滚即撤掉本 PR。
- 先看：`docs/adr/0152-scim-group-grants-only-an-ordinary-permission-set-through-a-per-connection-mapping.md` 的 Decision 一节（三项裁决），`docs/adr/0134-env-side-scim-provisioning.md` D4 下新增的一行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors`，预期 152 份记录全部解析通过、退出码 0。
- 需要你做的：批准本 PR（受管面 docs/adr，Tier H）。

## What changes

- **New `docs/adr/0152-scim-group-grants-only-an-ordinary-permission-set-through-a-per-connection-mapping.md`.** It records the three forks the maintainer ruled on #30959 (ruling record [`6718345088`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/30959#issuecomment-6718345088), verbatim 「以上都同意」, accepting the analysis [`6710730984`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/30959#issuecomment-6710730984)):
  - D1, fork 1 = (a): the mapping is one platform-object row per SCIM connection and group, typed columns, written by the platform administrator who mints the SCIM credential. The ruling's build note (the source column also fits an SSO group claim, #30967 item 3) is carried; the SSO half is not decided here.
  - D2, fork 2 = no: an IdP group never confers administrator standing; a mapping naming a set outside the organization boundary is refused at save; the card's last-admin 403 acceptance line is replaced by "refused at save"; the last-admin guard texts are corrected.
  - D3, fork 3 = (i): this new ADR plus one pointer line in ADR-0134 D4.
  - **The mechanism as landed** (facts, not decisions), each clause anchored by symbol into the code #31443 landed (`ed4b8322`): storage object, the two doors, the boundary predicate on the `security` service, the projection (`roles.map`, `roles.exists`, `reconcileUser` through the engine in the SCIM transaction, `APIError` mapping, the reason marker), the guard texts and the pinning test.
  - **The vendor-version fact, measured** on the installed package: `@better-auth/scim` is pinned at 1.7.12 (package.json, the `pnpm-workspace.yaml` override, the installed `package.json`); the `SCIMProjection` shape; and `runSCIMApplicationCallback`, which passes an `APIError` through and wraps anything else as a SCIM 500 "SCIM projection reconciliation failed".
  - **What this record does not decide**: SSO claims, multi-organization SCIM, organization-role or admin mapping, a Console surface, anything in `cloud ADR-0071`'s closed half.
- **`docs/adr/0134-env-side-scim-provisioning.md`**: one blockquote line under D4 pointing at ADR-0152. D4's text and the status line are unchanged, so the mirror stays equal to `cloud ADR-0071`.
- **`docs/adr/README.md`**: regenerated by `pnpm adr:index` (one new row, summary counts 150 → 151).

## Tests

None: docs-only diff, nothing to test or ablate. The record's anchors are checked mechanically (Verification).

## Acceptance notes

- **ADR number.** `origin/main` ends at ADR-0149; open PRs hold ADR-0150 (#31586) and ADR-0151 (#31615), so this record takes 0152. Both of those PRs also edit `docs/adr/README.md`; whichever lands later regenerates the index (row conflict only).
- **Status line.** `Accepted — implemented, 2026-11-08, …` following the README's status-hygiene convention (the implementation landed in #31443 before the record). The maintainer's merge is the acceptance act; if the maintainer prefers `Proposed` until then, it is a one-word change.
- **ADR-0134's vendor-version table** still names 1.7.2 as the pin. ADR-0152 restates the fact at 1.7.12 and leaves ADR-0134's dated measurement as written (append-only; outside this card's file surface).
- Seat 6's draft at `/mnt/project-files/server-lane-seat6/30959/adr-draft.md` does not exist in project files; the record was written from the card's rulings and the merged code.
